g.text: SAO++ edition of Adrian Studer's duckBATH (duckGLOW SAO, 2024, MIT).

g.desc: SAO++ edition of Adrian Studer's duckBATH (duckGLOW SAO, 2024, MIT).

g.text: His CH32V003, boost converter, reverse-polarity FET,

g.desc: His CH32V003, boost converter, reverse-polarity FET,

g.text: address jumpers and I2C pull-ups are replaced by the XIAO.

g.desc: address jumpers and I2C pull-ups are replaced by the XIAO.

g.text: SW1: SAO = badge feeds the 3.3 V rail. OFF = XIAO D1 high

g.desc: SW1: SAO = badge feeds the 3.3 V rail. OFF = XIAO D1 high

g.text: (through R4), firmware sleeps. USB-BAT = XIAO feeds the rail.

g.desc: (through R4), firmware sleeps. USB-BAT = XIAO feeds the rail.

g.text: Never USB and SAO at once.

g.desc: Never USB and SAO at once.

g.text: D1: common-anode RGB LED on the FRONT (the duck sits on it).

g.desc: D1: common-anode RGB LED on the FRONT (the duck sits on it).

g.text: Each colour is lit by pulling its XIAO pin LOW (PWM):

g.desc: Each colour is lit by pulling its XIAO pin LOW (PWM):

g.text: red D10, green D8, blue D7. GPIO2 carries WS2812 data in;

g.desc: red D10, green D8, blue D7. GPIO2 carries WS2812 data in;

g.text: SAO GPIO1 is not connected (the maker used it only to program his chip).

g.desc: SAO GPIO1 is not connected (the maker used it only to program his chip).
